تخامرت (form VI)
# تَخَامَرْتُ (taḵāmartu) /ta.xaː.mar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَخَامَرَ (taḵāmara)
# تَخَامَرْتَ (taḵāmarta) /ta.xaː.mar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَخَامَرَ (taḵāmara)
# تَخَامَرْتِ (taḵāmarti) /ta.xaː.mar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَخَامَرَ (taḵāmara)
# تَخَامَرَتْ (taḵāmarat) /ta.xaː.ma.rat/: third-person fem
